verses.original: תְּ֭פִלָּה לְעָנִ֣י כִֽי־ יַעֲטֹ֑ף יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ שִׂיחֽוֹ׃ וְלִפְנֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה שִׁמְעָ֣ה תְפִלָּתִ֑י יְ֭הוָה וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י תָבֽוֹא׃ אֵלֶ֥יךָ
verses.transliteration: tə·p̄il·lāh lə·‘ā·nî ḵî- ya·‘ă·ṭōp̄ yiš·pōḵ śî·ḥōw wə·lip̄·nê Yah·weh šim·‘āh ṯə·p̄il·lā·ṯî Yah·weh wə·šaw·‘ā·ṯî ṯā·ḇō·w ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: A prayer of one who is afflicted when he grows faint and pours out his lament before the LORD Hear my prayer O LORD let my cry for help come before You

verses.original: אַל־ תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ׀ מִמֶּנִּי֮ בְּי֪וֹם צַ֫ר לִ֥י הַטֵּֽה־ אָזְנֶ֑ךָ אֵלַ֥י עֲנֵֽנִי׃ מַהֵ֥ר בְּי֥וֹם אֶ֝קְרָ֗א
verses.transliteration: ’al- tas·têr pā·ne·ḵā mim·men·nî bə·yō·wm ṣar lî haṭ·ṭêh- ’ā·zə·ne·ḵā ’ê·lay ‘ă·nê·nî ma·hêr bə·yō·wm ’eq·rā
verses.literal: Do not hide Your face from me in my day of distress Incline Your ear to me answer me quickly when I call

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יָמָ֑י כָל֣וּ בְעָשָׁ֣ן וְ֝עַצְמוֹתַ֗י נִחָֽרוּ׃ כְּמוֹ־ קֵ֥ד
verses.transliteration: kî- yā·māy ḵā·lū ḇə·‘ā·šān wə·‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯay ni·ḥā·rū kə·mōw- qêḏ
verses.literal: For my days vanish like smoke and my bones burn like glowing embers . . .

verses.original: לִבִּ֑י הוּכָּֽה־ וַיִּבַ֣שׁ כָ֭עֵשֶׂב כִּֽי־ שָׁ֝כַ֗חְתִּי מֵאֲכֹ֥ל לַחְמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lib·bî hū·kāh- way·yi·ḇaš ḵā·‘ê·śeḇ kî·šā- šā·k̲aḥ·tî mê·’ă·ḵōl laḥ·mî
verses.literal: My heart is afflicted and withered like grass I even forget to eat my bread

verses.original: מִקּ֥וֹל אַנְחָתִ֑י לִבְשָׂרִֽי׃ דָּבְקָ֥ה עַ֝צְמִ֗י
verses.transliteration: miq·qō·wl ’an·ḥā·ṯî liḇ·śā·rî dā·ḇə·qāh ‘aṣ·mî
verses.literal: Through my loud groaning my skin hangs on my bones

verses.original: הָ֝יִ֗יתִי דָּ֭מִיתִי מִדְבָּ֑ר לִקְאַ֣ת כְּכ֣וֹס חֳרָבֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: hā·yî·ṯî dā·mî·ṯî miḏ·bār liq·’aṯ kə·ḵō·ws ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: I am like a desert owl like an owl among the ruins

verses.original: שָׁקַ֥דְתִּי וָאֶֽהְיֶ֑ה בּוֹדֵ֥ד כְּ֝צִפּ֗וֹר עַל־ גָּֽג׃
verses.transliteration: šā·qaḏ·tî wā·’eh·yeh bō·w·ḏêḏ kə·ṣip·pō·wr ‘al- gāḡ
verses.literal: I lie awake I am like a lone bird on a housetop

verses.original: כָּל־ הַ֭יּוֹם אוֹיְבָ֑י חֵרְפ֣וּנִי מְ֝הוֹלָלַ֗י בִּ֣י נִשְׁבָּֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hay·yō·wm ’ō·wy·ḇāy ḥê·rə·p̄ū·nî mə·hō·w·lā·lay bî niš·bā·‘ū
verses.literal: All day long my enemies taunt me they ridicule me and curse me

verses.original: כִּי־ אָכָ֑לְתִּי אֵ֭פֶר כַּלֶּ֣חֶם מָסָֽכְתִּי׃ וְ֝שִׁקֻּוַ֗י בִּבְכִ֥י
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ā·ḵā·lə·tî ’ê·p̄er kal·le·ḥem mā·sā·ḵə·tî wə·šiq·qu·way biḇ·ḵî
verses.literal: For I have eaten ashes like bread and mixed my drink with tears

verses.original: מִפְּנֵֽי־ זַֽעַמְךָ֥ וְקִצְפֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י נְ֝שָׂאתַ֗נִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: mip·pə·nê- za·‘am·ḵā wə·qiṣ·pe·ḵā kî nə·śā·ṯa·nî wat·taš·lî·ḵê·nî
verses.literal: because of Your indignation and wrath for You have picked me up and cast me aside

verses.original: יָ֭מַי נָט֑וּי כְּצֵ֣ל וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אִיבָֽשׁ׃ כָּעֵ֥שֶׂב
verses.transliteration: yā·may nā·ṭui kə·ṣêl wa·’ă·nî ’î·ḇāš kā·‘ê·śeḇ
verses.literal: My days are like lengthening shadows and I wither away like grass

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תֵּשֵׁ֑ב לְעוֹלָ֣ם וְ֝זִכְרְךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh Yah·weh tê·šêḇ lə·‘ō·w·lām wə·ziḵ·rə·ḵā lə·ḏōr wā·ḏōr
verses.literal: But You O LORD sit enthroned forever Your renown endures to all generations . . .

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה תָ֭קוּם תְּרַחֵ֣ם צִיּ֑וֹן כִּי־ עֵ֥ת לְ֝חֶֽנְנָ֗הּ כִּי־ מוֹעֵֽד׃ בָ֥א
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh ṯā·qūm tə·ra·ḥêm ṣî·yō·wn kî- ‘êṯ lə·ḥen·nāh kî- mō·w·‘êḏ ḇā
verses.literal: You will rise up and have compassion on Zion for it is time to show her favor . . . the appointed time has come

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עֲ֭בָדֶיךָ רָצ֣וּ אֶת־ אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְֽאֶת־ יְחֹנֵֽנוּ׃ עֲפָרָ֥הּ
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā rā·ṣū ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇā·ne·hā wə·’eṯ- yə·ḥō·nê·nū ‘ă·p̄ā·rāh
verses.literal: For Your servants delight in her stones and take pity on her dust

verses.original: ג֭וֹיִם אֶת־ וְיִֽירְא֣וּ שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וְֽכָל־ מַלְכֵ֥י הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ אֶת־ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ḡō·w·yim ’eṯ- wə·yî·rə·’ū šêm Yah·weh wə·ḵāl mal·ḵê hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- kə·ḇō·w·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: So the nations - will fear the name of the LORD and all the kings of the earth - [will fear] Your glory

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֣ה בָנָ֣ה צִיּ֑וֹן נִ֝רְאָ֗ה בִּכְבוֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- Yah·weh ḇā·nāh ṣî·yō·wn nir·’āh biḵ·ḇō·w·ḏōw
verses.literal: For the LORD will rebuild Zion He has appeared in His glory

verses.original: פָּ֭נָה אֶל־ תְּפִלַּ֣ת הָעַרְעָ֑ר וְלֹֽא־ בָ֝זָ֗ה אֶת־ תְּפִלָּתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: pā·nāh ’el- tə·p̄il·laṯ hā·‘ar·‘ār wə·lō- ḇā·zāh ’eṯ- tə·p̄il·lā·ṯām
verses.literal: He will turn toward the prayer of the destitute He will not despise - their prayer

verses.original: זֹ֭את תִּכָּ֣תֶב לְד֣וֹר אַחֲר֑וֹן וְעַ֥ם נִ֝בְרָ֗א יְהַלֶּל־ יָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ tik·kā·ṯeḇ lə·ḏō·wr ’a·ḥă·rō·wn wə·‘am niḇ·rā yə·hal·lel- yāh
verses.literal: Let this be written for the generation to come so that a people not yet created may praise the LORD

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִ֭שְׁקִיף מִמְּר֣וֹם קָדְשׁ֑וֹ יְ֝הוָ֗ה הִבִּֽיט׃ מִשָּׁמַ֤יִם׀ אֶל־ אֶ֬רֶץ
verses.transliteration: kî- hiš·qîp̄ mim·mə·rō·wm qā·ḏə·šōw Yah·weh hib·bîṭ miš·šā·ma·yim ’el- ’e·reṣ
verses.literal: For He looked down from the heights of His sanctuary the LORD gazed out from heaven to earth

verses.original: לִ֭שְׁמֹעַ אָסִ֑יר אֶנְקַ֣ת לְ֝פַתֵּ֗חַ בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: liš·mō·a‘ ’ā·sîr ’en·qaṯ lə·p̄at·tê·aḥ bə·nê ṯə·mū·ṯāh
verses.literal: to hear a prisoner’s groaning to release those condemned to death

verses.original: לְסַפֵּ֣ר שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֭צִיּוֹן וּ֝תְהִלָּת֗וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·sap·pêr šêm Yah·weh bə·ṣî·yō·wn ū·ṯə·hil·lā·ṯōw bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: that they may proclaim the name of the LORD in Zion and praise Him in Jerusalem

verses.original: עַמִּ֣ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וּ֝מַמְלָכ֗וֹת בְּהִקָּבֵ֣ץ לַעֲבֹ֥ד אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mîm yaḥ·dāw ū·mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ bə·hiq·qā·ḇêṣ la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: when peoples . . . and kingdoms assemble to serve - the LORD

verses.original: עִנָּ֖ה כֹּחוֹ בַדֶּ֥רֶךְ קִצַּ֥ר יָמָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘in·nāh kō·ḥō ḇad·de·reḵ qiṣ·ṣar yā·māy
verses.literal: He has broken my strength on the way He has cut short my days

verses.original: אֹמַ֗ר אֵלִ֗י אַֽל־ תַּ֭עֲלֵנִי בַּחֲצִ֣י יָמָ֑י שְׁנוֹתֶֽיךָ׃ בְּד֖וֹר דּוֹרִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: ’ō·mar ’ê·lî ’al- ta·‘ă·lê·nî ba·ḥă·ṣî yā·māy šə·nō·w·ṯe·ḵā bə·ḏō·wr dō·w·rîm
verses.literal: I say O my God do not take me in the midst of my days Your years [go on] through all generations . . .

verses.original: לְ֭פָנִים יָסַ֑דְתָּ הָאָ֣רֶץ שָׁמָֽיִם׃ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ
verses.transliteration: lə·p̄ā·nîm yā·saḏ·tā hā·’ā·reṣ šā·mā·yim ū·ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: In the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth and the heavens are the work of Your hands

verses.original: הֵ֤מָּה׀ יֹאבֵדוּ֮ וְאַתָּ֪ה תַ֫עֲמֹ֥ד וְ֭כֻלָּם יִבְל֑וּ כַּבֶּ֣גֶד כַּלְּב֖וּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵ֣ם וְֽיַחֲלֹֽפוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh yō·ḇê·ḏū wə·’at·tāh ṯa·‘ă·mōḏ wə·ḵul·lām yiḇ·lū kab·be·ḡeḏ kal·lə·ḇūš ta·ḥă·lî·p̄êm wə·ya·ḥă·lō·p̄ū
verses.literal: They will perish but You remain they will all wear out like a garment Like clothing You will change them and they will be passed on

verses.original: וְאַתָּה־ ה֑וּא וּ֝שְׁנוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִתָּֽמּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh- hū ū·šə·nō·w·ṯe·ḵā lō yit·tām·mū
verses.literal: But You remain the same and Your years will never end

verses.original: בְּנֵֽי־ עֲבָדֶ֥יךָ יִשְׁכּ֑וֹנוּ וְ֝זַרְעָ֗ם יִכּֽוֹן׃ לְפָנֶ֥יךָ
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā yiš·kō·w·nū wə·zar·‘ām yik·kō·wn lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: The children of Your servants will dwell securely and their descendants will be established before You
